decision_basis: Two separately identified workflow executions validated identical final candidate and validator blobs against the same frozen repository tree. Both discovered 59 proof records, including three proof-object-id, two canonical-id, and two hash-locked artifact-map proof records, validated 60 synthetic decisions, detected all 43 mutations, derived priority direction from the candidate model, and produced the same evidence digest.
supported_propositions: proof discovery must cover schema-aware self-registering records using proof_id proof_object_id and constrained canonical id fields
proof discovery must cover proof-bearing repository paths registered as keys of declared hash-locked artifact maps
the proof_object_id rule is limited to declared roots and JSON files
the canonical id rule is limited to declared roots JSON files and proof-bearing filenames
the artifact-map rule is limited to declared mapping fields source roots JSON paths and proof-bearing filenames
the frozen repository contains 59 registered proof records including seven records recovered by the three schema-aware extensions
proof discovery remains separate from artifact status and proof authority
numeric priority direction is derived from the candidate contract and lower numeric rank is higher authority
